ayahs.translationId: Demi matahari dan sinarnya pada pagi hari.
ayahs.translationEn: By the sun and its brightness
And [by] the moon when it follows it
And [by] the day when it displays it
And [by] the night when it covers it
And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
And [by] the earth and He who spread it
And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

ayahs.translationId: Maka Dia mengilhamkan kepadanya (jalan) kejahatan dan ketakwaannya.
ayahs.translationEn: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

ayahs.translationId: Sungguh beruntung orang yang menyucikannya (jiwa itu).
ayahs.translationEn: He has succeeded who purifies it,

ayahs.translationId: Dan sungguh rugi orang yang mengotorinya.
ayahs.translationEn: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

ayahs.translationId: (Kaum) Samud telah mendustakan (rasulnya) karena mereka melampaui batas (zalim),
ayahs.translationEn: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

ayahs.translationId: ketika bangkit orang yang paling celaka di antara mereka.
ayahs.translationEn: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.

ayahs.text: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
ayahs.translationId: Lalu Rasul Allah (Saleh) berkata kepada mereka, "(Biarkanlah) unta betina dari Allah ini dengan minumannya."
ayahs.translationEn: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."

ayahs.text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.translationId: Namun mereka mendustakannya dan menyembelihnya, karena itu Tuhan membinasakan mereka karena dosanya, lalu diratakan-Nya (dengan tanah).
ayahs.translationEn: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].

ayahs.translationId: Dan Dia tidak takut terhadap akibatnya.
ayahs.translationEn: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
